evals.prompt: alur login di app ini gimana sih? dari request masuk sampai token kesimpen. jelasin dong
evals.expected_output: Leads with a plain-text call graph in a `ts` fence rooted at the HTTP route (POST /api/login, not the controller), two-space-indented `→` children, followed by a `src:` block giving path:line for every unique node. Middleware/validation appear as nodes. Async or queued steps are marked [async]. No Mermaid. Per-node facts ride in the tree as `?` lines (which break points retry, recover, or are fatal) and `!` lines (anything acquired whose release isn't guaranteed on the error path); the two to five notes below carry only what spans the whole flow and never restate an arrow. Tree stays at or under ~25 nodes, with any elision marked `→ … (n more)` and explained. No Tests section unless the test wiring genuinely differs in shape.

evals.prompt: /call-graph what calls UserRepository::findByEmail? aku mau tau semua yang manggil ini sebelum aku ubah signature-nya
evals.expected_output: Inverted caller graph with `←` arrows and findByEmail as root, enumerating every caller found (including non-HTTP entry points like CLI commands and queue jobs, not just controllers), each traced up to its own entry point. `src:` block points at definitions. Callers found only by name-grep are confirmed by reading the call site; anything unresolvable is marked [unverified] with a reason rather than silently dropped or invented.

evals.prompt: port berapa sih service ini jalan di local?
evals.expected_output: Answers the single fact directly with the port and its source (path:line), and does NOT produce a call graph — this is exactly the trivial single-fact case the skill says to skip. Correct behavior here is restraint; drawing a tree would be a failure.

evals.prompt: gue baru join tim ini. bisa jelasin arsitektur project ini secara garis besar?
evals.expected_output: Proactively leads with a call graph of the codebase's main flow even though the user never asked for a graph — this is the 'include graphs in project overviews and architecture summaries' rule. Graph is verified with a `src:` block, then prose narrates around it (layering, conventions, where things live). Does not ask permission before drawing the graph, and does not answer with prose alone.

evals.prompt: ini flow screen buat fitur approve invoice: ada list invoice, klik salah satu buka detail, terus ada drawer buat approve. tolong petakan flow-nya, aku mau review sebelum mulai bikin komponennya
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the material is an interface flow, not code, and reads references/non-code-graphs.md. Nodes are surfaces with cardinality (list = many, detail = one), edges are the moves. Crucially enumerates void states per surface with `?` lines (empty / loading / partial / error / denied) and preconditions with `!` lines (selected record, permission, focus release for the drawer) — these are the substance of the answer, not decoration. Because nothing openable exists yet, the graph is titled [proposed] and carries NO fabricated `src:` block, with one line saying it reflects described intent rather than verified source.
